summary: Verified the RH-paper / config-switch-guard / readiness backend fixes on the running micro-stake bot without mutating state. All 5 targeted pytest suites pass (46 tests). The mutating-live guard skips PUT/POST integration tests as designed. GET /api/bot/config for the four switches was byte-identical before/after the pytest run. The 90s background-save window produced ZERO new 'CONFIG SWITCHES CHANGED' audit lines and the three RH/Helius switches did not change. A no-op PUT /api/bot/config {max_trade_usd:100.0} also produced zero audit lines. /api/readiness exposes rh_breaker_armed=true and reasons never say 'benched by the live-doctor breaker' while rh_live_trading is false. Frontend /dashboard loads with no console errors; the RH banner correctly reads 'RH not armed — paper and live are both off'.

test_results.targeted_suites: 46 passed in 1.40s (test_rh_paper 18, test_config_switch_guard 2, test_readiness 7, test_flush_hold_sol 5, test_ladder 14). Task said '~55'; actual collected count is 46 — matches all currently defined tests in those five files.
test_results.mutating_live_guard: test_rh_integration_api.py: 5 passed, 1 skipped with reason 'mutating live-API call — set PYTEST_LIVE_MUTATE=1 to run against the running bot' — as expected.

90s_background_save_wait.note: During the 95s wait the operator (via UI) started the bot: `enabled` flipped false→true. This did NOT go through save_config (audit delta is 0 and dedicated /api/bot/start does not emit that log line). The three switches (rh_feed_enabled, rh_paper_enabled, helius_tracker_enabled) remained unchanged, so the switch-guard invariant holds. The unit test test_background_save_never_touches_switches also passes.

test_results.noop_put_audit: PUT /api/bot/config {max_trade_usd:100.0} → 200. 'CONFIG SWITCHES CHANGED' audit lines delta = 0.
test_results.readiness: GET /api/readiness returns rh_breaker_armed=true (bool). reasons = ['bot STOPPED — press Start', 'RH not armed — paper and live are both off']. No 'benched by the live-doctor breaker' text.
test_results.frontend: Dashboard renders. Banner: 'RH NOT TRADING · OFF · RH not armed — paper and live are both off'. Zero console errors. Only hovered CONTROL tab — never clicked any toggle / Start / Stop / Save / Restore.

critical_code_review_comments: The task expected ~55 passing tests in the five targeted files but only 46 collected. Not a defect — most likely the estimate simply differed from the current file contents; worth confirming with main agent whether tests were consolidated/removed.
